name: Clinician Review Rubric v1

accuracy.description: How accurately the explanation reflects the pathology report findings.

completeness.description: Whether key report findings are covered without unnecessary omission.

harm_potential.description: Potential for the explanation to mislead or cause harm if taken at face value. Higher = more harm potential.

flagging.flagged_sentences: 0-based indices of explanation sentences that are unsupported, misleading, or harmful.

notes: Clinicians should not be shown model or prompt version during review.
